editorial.blurb: Rasika is a DC institution that delivers consistently excellent, beautifully presented Indian cuisine with the warm hospitality that has made it a premier destination for years.
editorial.insiderTip: Go with friends to share appetizers family-style—the Palak Chaat is a must-order starter, and the restaurant accommodates walk-ins when possible, though reservations are recommended.

topDishes.note: A must-try signature appetizer, consistently praised for perfect balance of flavors
